quotes.text: For `calendar-dialog.mjs`, retain `setCalendarEventRoute({ calendarId, eventId, recurrenceId })`: it atomically changes route attributes and clears a stale recurrence ID. `git ls-files -u` plus sequencer metadata, not detached HEAD, decides whether conflict work remains. Preserve a pre-staged `browser_calendarDialog.js`; validate marker scan, `node --check`, `MOZ_SKIP_PATH_PERFORMANCE_CHECK=1 ../mach commlint`, `git diff --check`, and `git diff --cached --check`. [Task 6]
